description: Baseline values for the agent-rigor scorecard. Values are fractions (0.0 to 1.0) except where noted. Targets are based on observed solo-developer behaviour with and without enforcement layers.

without_agent_rigor._note: Approximate behaviour of a disciplined solo developer using Claude Code WITHOUT the agent-rigor enforcement layer. Anecdotal but representative.

target_with_agent_rigor._note: Targets a disciplined solo developer should hit after 4-6 weeks of agent-rigor use. Not all targets are 1.0 — some require human waivers for legitimate edge cases.

thresholds._note: How the scorecard renders glyphs: ✓ ≥ target, = within tolerance, ⚠ < tolerance, ✗ < without_agent_rigor

drift_vocabulary_pattern: for now|por ahora|más adelante|mas adelante|\bMVP\b|quick fix|hack|temporal|temporary|good enough|TODO: test later|HACK:|XXX:|FIXME[^:]
